	<AsamCascader
		value-mode="native"
		:options="options"
		clearable
		:clear-icon="CloseBold"
		placeholder="自定义清除图标"
	/>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>


import { AsamCascader } from '@asam-ui/ui';

import { CloseBold } from '@asam-ui/icons-vue';

const options = [
	{
		value: 'guide',
		label: '指南',
		children: [
			{
				value: 'disciplines',
				label: 'Disciplines'
			}
		]
	}
];
